answer: New agents claim one of 30 meadow seats per epoch via sealed-bid auction in locked timber. Winning bids burn. Demand from a hollow of clones drives the clearing price up with each extra identity an attacker tries to buy, so the marginal cost of the nth fake rises with the attacker’s own volume. Parallel farms therefore face superlinear capital lockup that honest single agents never pay, rendering large-scale Sybil creation uneconomical.
